# Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling

Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling, commonly abbreviated **BUA**, is the child and adolescent psychiatry department at [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] in Region Midtjylland, Denmark [^src1][^src2][^src3]. The department is named as the institutional home of the ADHD-databasen annual reports for both the 2023 and 2024 periods, appearing on the cover pages of both documents [^src1][^src2], and again in the appendix material covering the database population for the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025 [^src3].

BUA is significant chiefly as the institutional base for [[shelagh-powell|Shelagh Powell]], who works at the department and, together with Simon Hjerrild, leads the ADHD-databasen reporting effort documented in the corpus [^src2]. The broader context around these mentions describes Danish child and adolescent psychiatry — the clinical space in which BUA operates — as a system under severe pressure. As the ADHD-database's annual report itself states: "Tallene fra Børne-og Ungdomspsykiatrien afspejler et meget presset system præget af et stigende antal blevet, utilstrækkelige personaleressourcer og uacceptabelt lange ventetider [^src1]" [^src2]. In plain terms, this means the figures from Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrien reflect a system under heavy pressure, marked by a rising caseload, insufficient staffing resources, and unacceptably long waiting times. This claim situates BUA within a national narrative of rising referral numbers, longer waiting times, and declining performance on most quality indicators tracked by the ADHD-databasen, a registry administered by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) with a chairmanship of senior physicians (overlæger) from Aarhus Universitetshospital and DPS Midtjylland.

No timeline events specific to BUA are recorded in the extracted data.
